Key Control: Purchase requisitions require approval based on delegated authority limits before procurement commitment
System and procurement procedures require an approved requisition before a purchase order is issued
New vendors require supporting documentation and independent approval by Finance

Risk: Fraudulent change to supplier bank account
Key Control: Changes to supplier bank details require independent verification and documented approval

Risk: Payment for goods or services not received
Key Control: Receiving personnel record receipt in the system before invoice payment eligibility
Accounts Payable performs a three-way match between PO receipt and invoice
Payment batches are reviewed and approved according to documented authority limits
Access rights are mapped to job roles and incompatible combinations are restricted
Finance maintains a monthly exception log and reports overdue items to management
Supporting documents and approval evidence are retained in a central document repository
